summary: Regression smoke test after react-native-google-mobile-ads downgrade (16.4.0 -> 15.4.0). Frontend web preview loads cleanly (POPULUS auth screen, no red screen, no bundler errors). Anonymous login -> /terms -> accept both checkboxes -> ACCETTO E CONTINUO -> lands on home '/'. Home feed renders 6 feud cards with correct testIDs (feud-card-*). Tapping a feud card opens /feud/{id} with feud-detail-screen mounted. AdBanner renders the expected web stub: testID 'ad-placeholder-feud-detail' with 'SPAZIO PUBBLICITARIO / Visibile solo nel build nativo di produzione' - NO crash, NO module-not-found. Console captured 0 [error] entries and 0 pageerror events; zero 'mobile-ads' / 'Cannot find module' strings across the full flow. Backend smoke: /api/categories 200 (list of 9), /api/feuds/hype?limit=3 200 (list with feud_id/title/party_a/party_b). NOTE: /api/health does NOT exist in server.py - only /api/ (returns {message: 'Populus API', ok: true}); this is a spec mismatch in the review request, not a bug. Nothing to fix; downgrade is safe from a runtime-in-web-preview perspective. EAS Android build itself must still be triggered by the user via Emergent Publish - out of scope for this agent.
